ValidationRule.description: If Approved Requested Card Type = Ila switch and Approved Transfer Type is blank
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c, 'Accept'), OR( ISPICKVAL(cc_Approved_Requested_Card_Type__c, 'PLATINUM_BALANCE_TRANSFER_01'), Is_Balance_Transfer__c = true ), ISBLANK(Text(cc_Approved_Transfer_Type__c)), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Card Cash Collateral Application") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Approver Transfer Type field for ila switch / ila Gulf Cards
